llm_judge_reasons: Incomplete coverage: Instruction requires TWO verifications - (1) duplicate slide 5 and (2) duplicated slide appears right after original slide 5
Evaluator only checks total slide count (17 slides), but does NOT verify which slide was duplicated
Evaluator does NOT verify the position of the duplicated slide (should be at position 6, right after position 5)
False positives possible: Agent could duplicate any slide (e.g., slide 1, slide 10) and still pass as long as total becomes 17
False positives possible: Agent could duplicate slide 5 but place it at the end (position 17) and still pass
Missing semantic verification: No check that slides at positions 5 and 6 have identical content
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Add verification for slide position: Check that the presentation has duplicate content at positions 5 and 6
Use python-pptx library to compare slide content: Extract and compare text/shapes from slides at positions 5 and 6
